coordinate_source.format: GeoNames country dump geoname tab-delimited schema

selection_rule.normalization: Unicode NFKD -> ASCII transliteration -> casefold -> collapse whitespace

stop_rules: stop if PT.zip cannot be downloaded and byte-identified reproducibly
stop if any target has zero or multiple T.ISL matches under the frozen normalization rule
stop if two targets resolve to the same geonameid
freeze the resulting latitude/longitude values exactly; do not move or snap coordinates after later climate coverage is seen
do not sample climate or parse species-island incidence in this gate
